name: Limit Return Criteria 2
definition: Defines the criteria used to report on limit.

StartDateTimeIndicator.name: Start Date Time Indicator
StartDateTimeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the limit start date time is requested.

StatusIndicator.name: Status Indicator
StatusIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the limit status is requested.

UsedAmountIndicator.name: Used Amount Indicator
UsedAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the limit used amount is requested.

UsedPercentageIndicator.name: Used Percentage Indicator
UsedPercentageIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the limit used percentage is requested.
